new_file_rule: All augmented selectors live in new Rust integration test file crates/ruff/tests/config_aug.rs via eval_tests_aug.patch.

requirement_sections: Allow override of configuration options via the CLI > Proposals
config_aug::isolated_inline_overrides_st.public_surface: ruff check --isolated with repeatable inline --config TOML options.

config_aug::isolated_inline_overrides_st.internal_symbol_check: No production internals imported; test invokes the ruff binary.

requirement_sections: Allow override of configuration options via the CLI > Proposals

config_aug::nested_pyproject_add_noqa_us.internal_symbol_check: No production internals imported; test invokes the ruff binary and observes file contents.

requirement_sections: Allow override of configuration options via the CLI > Proposals
